tools.name: buyer_questions
tools.description: Start an AI facts check: returns the questions a buyer asks about a company. Answer them yourself, with web search, before reading anything from the company.

tools.name: company_statements
tools.description: After you have answered the buyer questions: reads the company's pricing and service pages and returns its statements with instructions for comparing your answers.

tools.name: verify_findings
tools.description: Keeps only the differences whose quotes are really in your answer and on the company's page, and finds the pages your answer cited that carry a wrong figure. Call once per answer.
